name: Path of the Totem Warrior
summary: A barbarian guided by animal spirits that grant different powers at each step.

features.name: Spirit Seeker
features.short: Cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals as rituals.
features.summary: You can cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals, but only as rituals.

features.name: Totem Spirit
features.short: Choose an animal spirit that empowers your rage.
features.summary: Choose a totem animal. Its spirit grants you a benefit while you rage.

options.name: Bear
options.summary: While raging, resistance to all damage except psychic.

grants.text: Totem Spirit (Bear): While raging, resistance to all damage except psychic.

options.name: Eagle
options.summary: While raging, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage and you can Dash as a bonus action.

grants.text: Totem Spirit (Eagle): While raging, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage and you can Dash as a bonus action.

options.name: Elk
options.summary: While raging and not in heavy armor, +15 ft. walking speed.

grants.text: Totem Spirit (Elk): While raging and not in heavy armor, +15 ft. walking speed.

options.name: Tiger
options.summary: While raging, add 10 ft. to long jump and 3 ft. to high jump.

grants.text: Totem Spirit (Tiger): While raging, add 10 ft. to long jump and 3 ft. to high jump.

options.name: Wolf
options.summary: While raging, friends have advantage on melee attacks against enemies within 5 ft. of you.

grants.text: Totem Spirit (Wolf): While raging, friends have advantage on melee attacks against enemies within 5 ft. of you.

features.name: Aspect of the Beast
features.short: Choose a second animal for a lasting benefit.
features.summary: Choose a totem animal (it can be a different one). You gain a benefit that works all the time.

options.name: Bear
options.summary: Double carrying capacity; advantage on STR checks to push, pull, lift or break.

grants.text: Aspect of the Beast (Bear): Double carrying capacity; advantage on STR checks to push, pull, lift or break.

options.name: Eagle
options.summary: See up to 1 mile clearly; dim light doesn't hurt your Perception.

grants.text: Aspect of the Beast (Eagle): See up to 1 mile clearly; dim light doesn't hurt your Perception.

options.name: Elk
options.summary: Your group travels at double speed (with up to 10 companions).

grants.text: Aspect of the Beast (Elk): Your group travels at double speed (with up to 10 companions).

options.name: Tiger
options.summary: Gain two skill proficiencies from Athletics, Acrobatics, Stealth and Survival.

grants.text: Aspect of the Beast (Tiger): Gain two skill proficiencies from Athletics, Acrobatics, Stealth and Survival.

options.name: Wolf
options.summary: Track at a fast pace and move stealthily at a normal pace.

grants.text: Aspect of the Beast (Wolf): Track at a fast pace and move stealthily at a normal pace.

features.name: Spirit Walker
features.short: Cast Commune with Nature as a ritual.
features.summary: You can cast Commune with Nature, but only as a ritual.

features.name: Totemic Attunement
features.short: Choose a third animal for a powerful rage benefit.
features.summary: Choose a totem animal (it can be a different one). You gain a strong benefit while raging.

options.name: Bear
options.summary: While raging, enemies within 5 ft. have disadvantage attacking anyone but you.

grants.text: Totemic Attunement (Bear): While raging, enemies within 5 ft. have disadvantage attacking anyone but you.

options.name: Eagle
options.summary: While raging, you can fly at your walking speed (you fall at the end of your turn).

grants.text: Totemic Attunement (Eagle): While raging, you can fly at your walking speed (you fall at the end of your turn).

options.name: Elk
options.summary: While raging, bonus action to knock a Large or smaller creature prone and deal 1d12 + STR.

grants.text: Totemic Attunement (Elk): While raging, bonus action to knock a Large or smaller creature prone and deal 1d12 + STR.

options.name: Tiger
options.summary: While raging, after moving 20 ft. toward a target, make an extra melee attack as a bonus action.

grants.text: Totemic Attunement (Tiger): While raging, after moving 20 ft. toward a target, make an extra melee attack as a bonus action.

options.name: Wolf
options.summary: While raging, knock a Large or smaller creature prone with a melee hit (bonus action).

grants.text: Totemic Attunement (Wolf): While raging, knock a Large or smaller creature prone with a melee hit (bonus action).
